stories.title: Trump anuncia un acuerdo con Putin para que EE.UU. reciba diésel de Rusia

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Putin for U.S. to receive diesel from Russia
en.summary: The U.S. president announced an agreement with Russia's leader to supply millions of tons of diesel to American and global markets to reduce prices, addressing concerns among Republican allies about high fuel costs.

stories.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,7 sacude Panamá

en.title: Earthquake of magnitude 7.7 shakes Panama
en.summary: A powerful earthquake struck Panama, triggering tsunami alerts for multiple countries in the region including Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Peru, Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador, and Mexico.

stories.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,6 sacude Panamá y activa la alerta de tsunami

en.title: Earthquake of magnitude 7.6 shakes Panama and activates tsunami alert
en.summary: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake struck Panama with its epicenter near Pitaloza Arriba, triggering a tsunami alert that was later withdrawn, followed by several aftershocks of decreasing intensity.

stories.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,7 sacude Panamá y activa la alerta por tsunami en varios puntos del Pacífico

en.title: Earthquake of magnitude 7.7 shakes Panama and activates tsunami alert at several points in the Pacific
en.summary: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake centered near Tonosí in southern Panama triggered tsunami alerts across multiple Pacific locations.

stories.title: Maniobra de la izquierda para un vuelco en el Senado: PSOE y Frente Amplio negocian una alianza que les habría dado la mayoría clara en 2023

en.title: Left-wing maneuver for Senate shift: PSOE and Broad Front negotiate alliance that would have given them clear majority in 2023
en.summary: A left-wing coalition would have secured 116 Senate seats in elections, compared to the PSOE's 73 seats and Sumar's zero three years ago, while the PP would have obtained 81 senators instead of 120.

stories.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,2 sacude el sur de Panamá

en.title: 7.2 magnitude earthquake shakes southern Panama
en.summary: A strong earthquake struck southern Panama with no immediate reports of casualties or damage, though tsunami alerts were issued for certain coastal areas in other countries.

stories.title: Estados Unidos amenaza con "desmontar ladrillo a ladrillo" el Tribunal Penal Internacional tras el Nobel a Navi Pillay

en.title: United States threatens to "dismantle brick by brick" International Criminal Court after Nobel Peace Prize to Navi Pillay
en.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced new sanctions against the International Criminal Court, framing them as a response to the tribunal's actions on the same day the Nobel Peace Prize eluded Trump.

stories.title: El Nobel de la Paz a Navi Pillay desata la indignación de Israel en plena campaña electoral

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize to Navi Pillay sparks Israeli outrage during electoral campaign
en.summary: Israel's government rejected the Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African jurist Navi Pillay, who championed a UN report accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza.

stories.title: La jurista sudafricana Navi Pillay, Premio Nobel de la Paz 2026

en.title: South African jurist Navi Pillay, 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The Norwegian Committee awarded the Nobel Peace Prize to South African jurist Navi Pillay for her efforts in promoting peace, international law, and supporting victims of violence and conflict.

stories.title: Navi Pillay, la Nobel de la Paz que acusó a Israel de cometer un genocidio en Gaza

en.title: Navi Pillay, the Nobel Peace Prize winner who accused Israel of committing genocide in Gaza
en.summary: South African jurist Navi Pillay, aged 85, received the Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong work against apartheid, Rwandan massacres, and persecution of Rohingya people in Myanmar.

stories.title: South African lawyer Navi Pillay awarded 2026 Nobel Peace Prize

en.title: South African lawyer Navi Pillay awarded 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The Norwegian Nobel committee recognized South African lawyer Navi Pillay's efforts to promote peace and international law while bringing hope to victims of violence and conflict.

stories.title: El PSOE explora listas conjuntas de izquierdas frente a la mayoría del PP en el Senado

en.title: PSOE explores joint left-wing lists against PP majority in Senate
en.summary: Spanish Socialist party leadership is open to forming combined left-wing electoral lists for Senate elections, prioritizing Madrid despite difficulties in negotiations between groups and the tight timeframe of the November 29 election call.

stories.title: Warner Music compra el sello discográfico catalán Halley Records

en.title: Warner Music acquires Catalan record label Halley Records
en.summary: The American music industry giant has completed a full acquisition of the Catalan firm, which represents artists including Oques Grasses and Els Amics de les Arts in its catalog.

stories.title: Trump anuncia un pacto con Putin para que Rusia surta de diésel al mercado mundial

en.title: Trump announces deal with Putin for Russia to supply diesel to global market
en.summary: The announcement comes amid White House concerns about midterm election polling, which currently shows Democrats leading by seven points ahead of the November 3 vote.

stories.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 7,7 sacude Panamá

en.title: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake shakes Panama
en.summary: A powerful earthquake struck southeastern Panama on Friday with a depth of 10 kilometers, according to the U.S. Geological Survey.

stories.title: Golpe a los coches híbridos chinos: los modelos y marcas más afectados por las restricciones de la UE

en.title: Blow to Chinese hybrid cars: models and brands most affected by EU restrictions
en.summary: Chinese manufacturers including BYD, MG, Omoda, and others have significantly increased hybrid vehicle sales by exploiting a legal loophole that allows them to avoid EU tariffs imposed on Chinese electric vehicles.

stories.title: El aceite de oliva español, el inesperado gran beneficiario del pacto UE-China

en.title: Spanish olive oil, the unexpected big beneficiary of the EU-China deal
en.summary: The European Union secured a reduction in Chinese tariffs on olive oil, a product where Spain holds 80% market share. China ranks as the second-largest importer of Spanish olive oil outside the EU.
